name: Vorak Kresh

greeting.stranger: You've been asking too many questions. That's dangerous.
greeting.acquaintance: I warned you to stay away. You didn't listen.
greeting.friend: You think you can befriend me? I don't have friends, only assets and enemies.
greeting.confidant: You've made a mistake coming here. This ends now.

questRelated.iia_sytha_04_syndicate_exposure: So, you think you can expose me? You're a fool. The syndicate has connections throughout the galaxy. The Iron Dominion paid us well to keep quiet about Compound 7-Alpha, and we'll be paid even more to silence you. This ends now.

general: Business is business. I don't make the rules, I just profit from them.
The Concord? They're weak. They can't stop us.
You meddle in things you don't understand. That will be your undoing.
The galaxy runs on credits and fear. I provide both.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Expensive clothing, cybernetic left eye, always surrounded by guards

biography: Vorak Kresh is the ruthless leader of the criminal syndicate that controls Sytha's mining operations. A former Dominion officer who turned to crime after the Iron Dominion's fall, he's built a profitable operation through intimidation, bribery, and violence. He has connections to the Dominion Remnant and has been paid handsomely to keep quiet about Compound 7-Alpha. He's intelligent, cruel, and will stop at nothing to protect his interests.
